description: This C# source file defines the ShellContainerFactory class responsible for creating and configuring dependency injection containers for tenants in OrchardCore, including managing startup classes, features, and service providers.

classes.name: ShellContainerFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and configuring service containers for OrchardCore tenants, managing startup classes, features, and dependency injection setup.

methods.name: CreateContainerAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates and configures a service provider container for a tenant based on shell settings and blueprint.

methods.name: EnsureApplicationFeature
methods.description: Initializes the application feature if it has not been set, based on the extension manager and hosting environment.

methods.name: PopulateTypeFeatureProvider
methods.description: Registers all dependency-injected types with their associated features in the ITypeFeatureProvider.
